name: @droneey/kit
description: Runtime packages for TypeScript and Python, each with the constitution's rules for its slice.

scripts.lint:check: biome check --error-on-warnings && uv run --locked ruff check
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write && uv run --locked ruff check --fix
scripts.type:check: tsc --noEmit && bun run --filter './packages/*/typescript/*' type:check && uv run --locked ty check --config-file .droneey/constitution/presets/python/ty/foundation/self.toml -c 'environment.extra-paths=["packages/eros/python/core/tests", "packages/eros/python/wire/tests", "packages/eros/python/fastapi/tests", "packages/eros/python/fastmcp/tests"]'
scripts.complexity:check: for package in packages/*/python/*; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project ../../../.. complexipy src tests || exit 1; done
scripts.architecture:check: depcruise packages libs --config .dependency-cruiser.mjs && bun run --filter './packages/*/typescript/*' architecture:check && for package in packages/*/python/*; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project ../../../.. lint-imports --no-logo || exit 1; done
scripts.test:check: CI=1 bun test && for package in packages/*/python/*; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project ../../../.. pytest --cov || exit 1; done
scripts.mutation:check: bun .droneey/constitution/tools/mutation-check/dist/main.js && for package in packages/*/python/*; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project ../../../.. python ../../../../.droneey/constitution/tools/mutmut-check/dist/mutmut-check.pyz || exit 1; done
scripts.mutation:all: bun .droneey/constitution/tools/mutation-check/dist/main.js all && for package in packages/*/python/*; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project ../../../.. python ../../../../.droneey/constitution/tools/mutmut-check/dist/mutmut-check.pyz all || exit 1; done
scripts.secrets:check: betterleaks git . --redact --no-banner && betterleaks git . --pre-commit --redact --no-banner && betterleaks git . --pre-commit --staged --redact --no-banner
scripts.unused:check: knip --no-config-hints && knip --strict --no-config-hints && for package in packages/*/python/*; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project ../../../.. vulture || exit 1; done
scripts.dependencies:check: for package in packages/*/python/*; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project ../../../.. deptry src || exit 1; done
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint:check && bun run packages:check && bun run type:check && bun run code:check && bun run complexity:check && bun run architecture:check && bun run test:check && bun run mutation:check && bun run secrets:check && bun run names:check && bun run unused:check && bun run dependencies:check && bun run audit:check
